events.title: Rivian Q1 Earnings Beat on Higher Deliveries and Software Strength
events.body: RIVN beats Q1 estimates as deliveries jump and software surges, but rising costs and automotive losses weigh on margins and cash flow outlook.

events.title: LKQ Q1 Earnings Match Estimates, Revenues Beat on Stronger Sales Mix
events.body: LKQ Q1 revenues top estimates as pricing and mix offset softer volumes, but margins face pressure from tariffs, costs and weaker claims demand.
